title: Attention to Mamba: A Recipe for Cross-Architecture Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2604.14191v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: State Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba have become a popular alternative to Transformer models, due to their reduced memory consumption and higher throughput at generation compared to their Attention-based counterparts. On the other hand, the community has built up a considerable body of knowledge on how to train Transformers, and many pretrained Transformer models are readily available. To facilitate the adoption of SSMs while leveraging existing pretrained Transformers, we aim to identify an effective recipe to distill an Attention-based model into a Mamba-like architecture. translated_title: 从Attention到Mamba：一种跨架构蒸馏的方法配方
translated_abstract: 诸如Mamba等状态空间模型（SSM）已成为Transformer模型的流行替代方案，因为与基于注意力的模型相比，它们具有更低的内存消耗和更高的生成吞吐量。另一方面，社区已经积累了大量关于如何训练Transformer的知识，并且许多预训练的Transformer模型随时可用。为了在利用现有预训练Transformer的同时促进SSM的采用，我们旨在确定一种将基于注意力的模型有效蒸馏到类Mamba架构的方法配方。然而，在先前关于跨架构蒸馏的工作中已经表明，从Transformer到Mamba的朴素蒸馏方法无法保留原始教师模型的性能，这一限制通常通过结合Attention和SSM块的混合架构方案来克服。我们工作的关键论点是，通过为Mamba配备一种有原则的初始化（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一套将预训练的Attention架构Transformer模型有效蒸馏到Mamba状态空间模型架构的方法配方，使蒸馏后的Mamba模型能够保留教师模型的性能，从而加速SSM架构的落地采用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an effective recipe for distilling pretrained Attention-based Transformer models into Mamba-like State Space Model architectures, enabling the distilled models to preserve teacher performance and facilitating the adoption of SSMs.
